title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Low-Balance Disconnect Windows and Weather Holds
content:
A low-balance disconnection of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) meter runs only inside a permitted window. The window is the same on every tier; the weather hold applies only on the tiers marked below.

**Window on every tier** (PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40, PrePay Power Seasonal, PrePay Power Outbuilding, PrePay Power Small Commercial):

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Earliest local time of day | 09:00 |
| Latest local time of day | 15:00 |
| Saturdays and Sundays | no disconnections |
| Cooperative holidays | no disconnections |
| Friday cutoff | no disconnection after 12:00 on a Friday |
| Weather-hold day: forecast low at or below | 32 degrees Fahrenheit |
| Weather-hold day: forecast high at or above | 95 degrees Fahrenheit |

**Weather hold by tier**

| Tier | Disconnections suspended on weather-hold days |
|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | yes |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | yes |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | yes |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | yes |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | no |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | no |

Condition, judgement, result (hypothetical days):
- Forecast low of 32 degrees on a Tuesday, PrePay Power Seasonal: a weather-hold day, so no low-balance disconnection runs. A forecast low of 33 degrees is not a weather-hold day on the cold side.
- Forecast high of 95 degrees on a Wednesday, PrePay Power Outbuilding: the weather hold does not apply on this tier, so the day stays within the window on that ground.
- A Friday at 13:00 on any tier: after the Friday cutoff, so no low-balance disconnection runs.
